requirements.requirement: The system must transform PI name and institution fields into display-ready strings matching the S1 data contract.
The system must format prior trial count as a human-readable string (e.g., '12 trials') when a valid numeric value is provided.
The system must convert publication indicator boolean into a display-ready label (e.g., 'Published' or 'No publications').
The system must compute a visual score contribution indicator based on PI score contribution input from the S1 schema.
The system must normalize score contribution values into a bounded range suitable for UI rendering (e.g., 0–100 or equivalent scale).
The system must omit or hide fields from the display output when their corresponding input values are null or undefined.
The system must provide fallback display text (e.g., 'Not available') for required fields that are present but empty strings.
The system must ensure the transformed output conforms to the structured format required by MessageBubble.tsx rendering pipeline.
The system must preserve field ordering in the transformed output as defined by the S1 UI data contract.
The system must handle zero trial count as a valid value and display it explicitly (e.g., '0 trials').
The system must not throw runtime errors when all PI fields are missing and must return a safe empty or minimal display structure.
The system must handle invalid data types (e.g., string instead of number for trial count) by coercing or excluding the field without breaking rendering.
The system must generate consistent output structure for identical input data across repeated executions.
The system must support partial PI data inputs and render only the available fields without introducing placeholder artifacts.
